scope: Mechanical source and execution bridge only; independent ROOT semantic7, portable and final seal remain separate gates.
SQL:
SELECT r.node_id rnode,r.resolutionId,r.content,r.note,rr.edge_id refedge,
cr.node_id crnode,cr.tdocNumber,cr.title,cr.clausesAffected,
mo.edge_id modedge,sp.node_id spnode,sp.specNumber,sp.specRelease
FROM Resolution r
JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id
JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=rr.dst_id
JOIN rel_MODIFIES mo ON mo.src_id=cr.node_id
JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=mo.dst_id
WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected<>''
ORDER BY r.resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber,sp.specNumber

PhysCellID and DownlinkConfigCommon are mandatory present during the path switch between a serving cell and a L2 U2N relay UE in ServingCellConfigCommon. But the physCellID and downlinkConfigCommon are not useful during the diret to indirect path switch and NW may choose not to provide such IEs. The two IEs should only be mandatory during indirect to direct path switch.

Clarify PhysCellID and DownlinkConfigCommon is mandatory present during the path switch from a L2 U2N relay UE to a serving cell.Impact analysisImpacted 5G architecture options:NR SAImpacted functionalityNR sidelink relayInter-operability: If network implements the change but not the UE, path switch from direct to indirect may fail.If the UE implements the change but not the network, there is no inter-operability issue.

At RAN2#120 it was agreed to add a NOTE that “When sl-SyncPriority in SIB12 is set to gnbEnb, the choice of synchronisation source for an out of coverage L2 U2N Remote UE is left to UE implementation” This NOTE contradicts to the concept of the previous normative specifications where there are clear rules how the UE selects the synchronization source for SL. Moreover, we should also consider that if the Remote UE has received SIB12 via a Relay UE, then it should be synchronized already from some source.

The NOTE 1 in clause 5.8.6.2 is revised in the following way: “When an out of coverage L2 U2N Remote UE receives SIB12 with sl-SyncPriority set to gnbEnb, the L2 U2N Remote UE continues using the current synchronization source (GNSS or SyncRef UE) until higher priority synchronization source is found or the current synchronization source becomes unreliable.”Impact analysisImpacted functionality: SL Relay functionalityInter-operability: Implementation of this CR by a Release 17 UE will not cause compatibility issues.

RAN2 agreed in the last meeting that an out-of-coverage L2 U2N remote UE upon receiving SIB12 with the field sl-SyncPriority set to gNBeNB, the choice of synchronization source is left to UE implementation. 	Agreements:	Alternative Proposal 1 (modified): Add a NOTE in 5.8.6.2: “When the field sl-SyncPriority in SIB12 t is set to gNBeNB, the choice of synchronisation source for a L2 U2N Remote UE out of coverage is left to UE implementation. “.	RAN2 foresee no RAN1 impact from this decision.However, this violates the current priority rule for synchronization as set by RAN1 in Rel-16.

When UE receives RRCReconfiguration message for path switching from indirect to direct path, UE performs random access and starts T304. For the source inirect path, the timing to execute source link release is up to UE implementation. In addition, the RRCReconfiguration message to the L2 U2N Relay UE can be sent any time after transmitting RRCReconfiguration message to the remote UE based on gNB implementation (see TS38.300, 16.12.6.1). That means the remote UE still can receive NotificationMessageSidelink message or PC5 unicast link release due to e.g RLF from the source relay UE. According to 5.3.7.2 of TS38.331, upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer, the U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure.It is obious that the remote UE does not initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure during path switching upon receiving PC5 unicast link release from the source relay UE.Regarding NotificationMessageSidelink, there is a ‘NOTE 2’ in 5.8.9.10.4 to ensure that re-establishment procedure will not be triggered if UE receives NotificationMessageSidelink and T304 is running. NOTE 2:	The L2 U2N Remote UE may ignore the NotificationMessageSidelink if it does not release the PC5 unicast link in source side yet during an indirect-to-direct path switch, i.e. T304 is running.Therefore, the above case associated with PC5 unicast link release should be avoided. One NOTE also can be introduced to address it.
In section 5.3.7.2, one NOTE is added.

‘perform the Uu message transfer procedure in accordance with 5.8.9.9’ is added in 5.8.9.8.3. In 5.3.2.3, ‘perform the Uu message transfer procedure in accordance with 5.8.9.9’ is replaced by ‘inititate the Uu Message transfer in sidelink to that UE as specified in 5.8.9.9’.

In Rel-16/Rel-17 a UE performs power control for SL transmission as describled in clause 16.2 in TS 38.213, according to which DL pathloss based power control is enabled when: For PSBCH, if dl-P0-PSBCH is provided;For PSSCH/PSCCH, if dl-P0-PSSCH-PSCCH is provided;For PSFCH, if dl-P0-PSFCH is provided.During L2 U2N relay operation, a Remote UE that is out of coverage, can receive SIBs from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE, which means it can receive dl-P0-PSBCH/ dl-P0-PSSCH-PSCCH/ dl-P0-PSFCH when they are included in SIB12. However, the Remote UE can not perform the DL pathloss based power control for SL transmission as the DL path loss info is not available to remote UE in this case. Therefore, in this CR, it is clarified that a L2 U2N Remote UE which is out of coverage should disable the DL pathloss based power control even when dl-P0-PSBCH/ dl-P0-PSSCH-PSCCH/ dl-P0-PSFCH are included in SIB12.

In 6.3.5, Add a sentence in the field description of dl-P0-PSBCH, dl-P0-PSSCH-PSCCH and dl-P0-PSFCH, to clarify that the OoC Remote UE should consider that DL pathloss based power control is disabled for PBSCH/PSCCH/PSSCH/PSFCH even when dl-P0-PSBCH, dl-P0-PSSCH-PSCCH and dl-P0-PSFCH are included in SIB12.Impact analysisImpacted 5G architecture options:NR SA Impacted functionalityPower control for SL transmission when L2 U2N Remote UE is out of coverageInter-operability: There is no inter-operability issue as the change only has impact on L2 U2N Remote UE behavour.

The condition for inclusion of the field sbas-ID in GNSS assistance data from TS 37.355 is not reflected in the posSIB definitions in TS 38.331.  This omission allows the possibility that a network sends GNSS assistance data in a posSIB that indicates applicability to both an SBAS and a (non-SBAS) GNSS, and a UE that receives such a posSIB does not know whether it should apply to the indicated GNSS or SBAS.Alternatively, a network could indicate gnss-id=sbas, but then fail to include the sbas-id, and the UE would not know which SBAS the assistance data applied to.
The Need R condition on sbas-id in PosSIB-Type is changed to a condition indicating that sbas-id is mandatory present if gnss-id is set to sbas, and absent otherwise.

The target device may use the SSR-ClockCorrectionList to compute a clock correction to be applied to the broadcast satellite clock parameters, identified by iod of corresponding GNSS-SSR-OrbitCorrections.Therefore, the Note 2 for GNSS-SSR-OrbitCorrections has to sort of the ambiguity for Galileo.

So, it is better to clarify the “non-relay” part in the sentence in 16.9.5.Issue 3: U2N remote UE only use mode 2 for sidelink discovery transmissions but this restriction is not applicable to non-relay discovery, which has not been included in the exceptions mentioned in 16.9.5.Issue 4: Both “SL retransmission timer” and “SL HARQ retransmission timer” are used in the clauses for SL-DRX, which may be misunderstood that those are two different types of ReTx timers used for SL-DRX. The names needs to be aligned.

Issue1: The current spec mentions that the UE shall transmit periodic SRS or semi-persistent SRS when the validation for the SRS has passed. However, the semi-persistent SRS is still subject to the activation/deactivation command from the network and is not solely dependent on the validation for SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE. This needs to be clarified in the spec.Issue2: UE can request Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request using MAC CE only if Scheduling Request Configuration has been configured by RRC layer.  In MAC specification, in section 5.25 it mentions to trigger a Scheduling Request for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE. However, it is unclear as what configurations UE shall check before triggering the SR; since;There are two ways to send SR from the UE to the network (a) by PUCCH resource and (b) by RACH procedureFor (a), a UE can only send the SR on PUCCH with RRC configuration While for (a), when there is no SR configuration corresponding to the triggered SR, the UE would trigger SR on PRACH, according to the clause specified in 5.4.4.Thus, in section 5.25; the reference for section 5.4.4 should be provided where it says The MAC entitity Shall  “trigger a Scheduling Request for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE.”, so that it is clear as how UE can send the SR from the UE to the NW for intended positioning measurement gap activation/deactivation.Issue3: There is a typo in the section for SP positoning SRS activation/deactivation MAC CE

According to the initiation procedure 5.8.3.3, the SUI message uses for L3 Relay UE or L3 Remote UE will just use sl-TxResourceReqL3U2N-Relay, which is as same as R16 legacy sl-TxResourceReq structure. Therefore, the sl-DestinationIdentityL2U2N will not be used by L3 remote or L3 relay.

Issue 1: “non-relay’ discovery RX is wrongly specified as “relay discovery” in one of the SUI triggering procedures.Issue 2: The logic opposite of “A or B” is “neither A nor B”. Thus, it is wrong to use  “else” of “if A or B”  condition to mean “not A” or “not B”. Hence, for SUI initiation procedure in 5.8.3.2,  when the if branch is specified as “if configured by upper layer for L3 U2N relay or if configured by upper layers for L2 U2N relay”, the “else” condition will only be satisfied if the upper layer disables both L3 U2N relay and L2 U2N relay operation simultaneously.  However, the real intention of this “else” branch refers to the opposite of either one of the two cases (either L3 U2N relay or L2 U2N relay, not necessarily both. So, according to the current procedure, there are several “else” branches will not be properly triggered if UE has ever been acting in both L3 U2N relay and L2 U2N relay operation, but only one type of the relay operation is now disabled by upper layers.

Correted the “non-relay discovery RX” case for SUI initiaiton in 5.8.3.2 Replaced the “else” with an explicit list of two “if” consitons when UE is no longer configured by upper layers for L3 U2N or L2 U2N operation in the following cases:RX L3 U2N or L2 U2N relay discovery messageTX L3 U2N or L2 U2N relay discovery messageTX L3 U2N or L2 U2N relay communicationImpact analysisImpacted functionality: Actions related to SUI initaiton for SL relay.Inter-operability: If Sidelink UE implement this change, there is no inter-operability issue between UE and gNB.If Sidelink TX UE implement this change, but the Sidelink RX UE is not implemented this change, there is no inter-operability issue .

According to Rel-17 L2 U2N relay, relay UE can decide to transmit NotificationMessageSidelink or PC5 unicast link release due to Uu RLF or HO of relay UE. Based on 5.8.9.10.4, the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure upon receiving the NotificationMessageSidelink if T301 is not running. Based on 5.3.7.7 of TS38.331, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE upon receiption of NotificationMessageSidelink indicating relayUE-HO or relayUE-CellReselection if T301 is running.Regarding the reception of PC5 unicast link release, UE shall initiate the re-establishment procedure upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer at L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED in current specification. Therefore, the condition of T301 is missing for the case of the reception of PC5 unicast link release from relay UE. Upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer at L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED, UE shall initiate the re-establishment procedure if T301 is not running. L2 U2N Remote UE shall enter RRC_IDLE upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer if T301 is running.

In 5.3.7.2, the condition of ‘T301 is not running’ is added to ‘upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer at L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED. In 5.3.7.7, the condition of ‘upon PC5 unicast link release indicated by upper layer at L2 U2N Remote UE’ is added.

R2-2303922 in RAN2#121b was raised for addressing this issue, but the Rapporteur suggested to change “if the UE is acting as L2 U2N Remote UE for the destination” to “if the UE was acting as L2 U2N Remote UE for the destination” and come to it in this meeting.On the other hand, some editorial corrections in clause 5.8.3.2 and clause 5.8.6.1 are proposed.

The determination of the accuracy is one of the major tasks of GNSS receiver and the increased accuracy is very important especially in the multi-path environment like urban canyon for many use cases. In order to achieve it, the assistance information of Line of  Sight (LOS) / Non Line of Sight (NLOS) of satellites of a particular satellite in a given location is required to assist GNSS receiver.
The support of assistance information about LOS/NLOS GNSS satellites is introduced as two new posSIBs.

Downlink positioning methods require knowledge of the system time by the target UE.  However, a L2 U2N remote UE may be unable to obtain the system time because of lacking a direct Uu link and potentially being out of Uu coverage.A L2 U2N remote UE cannot request posSIBs from the relay UE, which reduces the benefits of posSIBs by forcing remote UEs to use unicast LPP to request assistance data.

An SFN-DFN offset is added to the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message sent from the L2 U2N relay UE, allowing the remote UE to infer the SFN timeline from the DFN timeline.A requested posSIB list is added to the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message.An indication of support for the SFN-DFN offset by the remote UE is added to the UECapabilityInformationSidelink message.An indication of support for forwarding the posSIB by the remote UE is added to the UECapabilityInformationSidelink message.
A UE when operating as an NR L2 UE-to-network relay UE needs to indicate its capability to the network.

Adding a UE capability to indicate whether the UE, when operating as an NR L2 sidelink relay UE, supports forwarding of posSIBs or not.Adding a UE capability to indicate whether the UE, when operating as an NR L2 sidelink relay UE, supports indication of the offset between SFN and DFN timelines or not.
